programmes.d: Jeffrey Ortiz, a mentally challenged man with the mental capacity of a nine-year-old, is making himself a sandwich when he inexplicably falls, striking his head on the kitchen counter.
When the husband, Tao Chen, is shot to death by his wife Jun, she claims she pulled the trigger in self-defense when a drunken Tao came after her with a gun.
After a brief illness, 34-year old Claire Jackson dies suddenly in the hospital from massive liver failure and winds up in Dr. G’s morgue.
A quadriplegic woman loved by her community is found dead in an Orlando park 150ft from her motorized wheelchair. Children find her lifeless body face down in the sand.
Jerra Kirby, who’s visiting family in Orlando, has suddenly passed out at a theme park wave pool and the paramedics are trying desperately to revive her.
Chris Schaffer has not been seen or heard from in five days. Finally, his friends find him dead and decomposed in the driver’s seat of his van.
Ricky Hawthorne, a middle-aged man with a history of AIDS, arrives at his local hospital complaining of chest pains. Doctors perform extensive tests on him but find nothing wrong and release him.
The farmers go on their first solo dates and Jennifer Nettles leave the farmers a troubling letter.
The farmers and their ladies head to South Carolina for a college football game.
The four farmers head out on their second solo dates.
Ty hosts a roping event at his farm in Missouri. Jennifer encourages the farmers to up the romance.
The farmers are invited on a surprise date with a new potential love match.
The whole crew grows camping and each couple must reckon with their feelings.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Secrets
programmes.d: In this TV special, an embarrassing secret prohibits a heart attack patient from being rushed to the ER for surgery. A man with a 5-hour erection gets caught between his wife and his mistress.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Temptations
programmes.d: In this TV special, a man comes into the ER with a surprising body part stuck inside a camping stove.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Worst Day Ever
programmes.d: In this TV special, two skydivers land on a metal post and a woman is rushed into the ER with a tie rod sticking out of her temple. Then, a woman arrives with a stiletto heel stuck in her ear.
